C-47.Name: Advanced agent setup: Claude Code hooks that open agent-written Markdown in Mark and feed the user's edits back
C-47.Summary: Next to the universal prompt (C-40 R-1a) the Guide and the welcome screen offer "Advanced agent setup" (user 2026-10-15). It installs two Claude Code hooks so nothing depends on the agent remembering instructions: PostToolUse on Write/Edit/MultiEdit opens a written .md in Mark in the background (open -g -a Mark); UserPromptSubmit compares the .md files the agent wrote with the hash recorded at its last write and, when the user changed them in Mark, adds a short "the user edited plan.md" diff to Claude's context.

Problem.Description: The prompt-only setup relies on the agent following instructions; hooks make the loop automatic. User: «про хуки я бы добавил вариант типа адвенсед агент сетап».

Goals.R-1: A small hook script shipped with Mark (shell or node-free binary call to the Mark CLI) handling both events; state (path → hash at the agent's last write) in a per-project file under .claude/.
Goals.R-2: "Advanced agent setup" panel: shows exactly what will be added to which settings file (project .claude/settings.json or ~/.claude/settings.json), asks for confirmation, merges without clobbering existing hooks, and can remove them again.
Goals.R-3: Desktop edition writes the settings after confirmation; the App Store edition (sandbox, no access to ~/.claude) shows copy-paste steps instead.
Goals.R-4: Other agents with hook systems (e.g. Cursor) as a later phase; agents without hooks keep the universal prompt.
Goals.R-5: All UI text in the 10 languages; the diff injected into the agent stays short (changed lines only, capped).

A1.Title: Prototype hooks for the Mark repo only (.claude/settings.local.json), dogfood

A2.Title: Advanced setup panel + install/uninstall in the desktop edition; copy-paste in the App Store edition

Constraints.Constraint: Never edit a user's Claude settings without an explicit confirmation showing the exact change; uninstall restores the previous state.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: With the hooks installed, Claude Code writes plan.md → Mark opens it without focus steal; the user edits it in Mark; on the next prompt Claude receives the user's change without being told.

AffectedAreas.Bundle: hook script, Guide/welcome panel, settings merge

C-47.VerificationIntent: Unit tests for the settings merge and the edit detection; a scripted end-to-end run with a fake agent writing files.
